scope: Small primary-source mechanism check, reusing existing shortlist; no broad literature search, author execution or downloads.

sources.title: The Virtual Seismologist method: a Bayesian approach to earthquake early warning
sources.access: Full author-hosted 39-page chapter PDF accessible in web tool; revisited posterior and single-station ambiguity sections
sources.checked_overlap: Joint magnitude/location posterior, magnitude-distance ambiguity and prior-dependent rare-event/false-alert tradeoff. Generic marginalization is established prior art.
sources.limits: No matched GeoNet magnitude scores or novelty assertion.

sources.title: A Bayesian Method for Real-Time Earthquake Location Using Multiparameter Data
sources.access: Full primary publisher HTML accessible; checked observation and Bayesian-update methods
sources.checked_overlap: Differential P times, amplitude ratios and backazimuth jointly update location uncertainty. This motivates distinguishing arrival-only from amplitude-conditioned geometry.
sources.limits: No magnitude-tail or first-network-P GeoNet benchmark inference.

sources.title: Earthquake magnitude and location estimation from real time seismic waveforms with a transformer network
sources.version: Existing shortlist identifies v2, 14 April 2021, 44 pages
sources.access: Full primary preprint accessible; revisited station features, amplitude preservation, location and multitask discussion
sources.checked_overlap: Variable-station direct waveform/coordinate fusion is a strong same-information control. Geometry auxiliary supervision needs matched control access.
sources.limits: No new benchmark number or claim that architecture cannot be improved.

sources.title: Toward Trustworthy Earthquake Catalogs in the Era of Automated Detection: A Probabilistic Framework for Robust Earthquake Location
sources.access: Full primary HTML accessible; checked hierarchical error-model methods
sources.checked_overlap: Neural travel-time surrogate with Student-t scale mixtures and phase contamination for robust catalogue locations. Robust locator modifications are not novel ingredients.
sources.limits: Catalogue location, not evidence for EEW magnitude-tail improvement; no repair implemented/tested here.

prose_budget: Paper-derived prose below 200 words per source across report/handoff/ledger; formulas, invented-law choices and calculations are agent derivations.
pin_limits: Version/DOI/URL and access scope recorded. Web bodies were not downloaded or byte-hash pinned. Workspace scientific/design inputs and all calculation outputs are byte pinned in manifest.json.
